props.name: Action Extrapolation
props.description: Action to take for gaps past the Active Action's range (when evaluating with NLA)

items.name: Nothing
items.description: Strip has no influence past its extents

items.name: Hold
items.description: Hold the first frame if no previous strips in track, and always hold last frame

props.name: Action Blending
props.description: Method used for combining Active Action's result with result of NLA stack

items.name: Replace
items.description: The strip values replace the accumulated results by amount specified by influence

items.name: Combine
items.description: The strip values are combined with accumulated results by appropriately using addition, multiplication, or quaternion math, based on channel type

items.name: Add
items.description: Weighted result of strip is added to the accumulated results

items.name: Subtract
items.description: Weighted result of strip is removed from the accumulated results

items.name: Multiply
items.description: Weighted result of strip is multiplied with the accumulated results

props.name: Action Influence
props.description: Amount the Active Action contributes to the result of the NLA stack

props.name: Tweak Mode Action Storage
props.description: Storage to temporarily hold the main action while in tweak mode

props.name: Tweak Mode Action Slot Storage
props.description: Storage to temporarily hold the main action slot while in tweak mode

props.name: NLA Evaluation Enabled
props.description: NLA stack is evaluated when evaluating this block

props.name: Use NLA Tweak Mode
props.description: Whether to enable or disable tweak mode in NLA

props.name: Action Slot Handle
props.description: A number that identifies which sub-set of the Action is considered to be for this data-block

props.name: Last Action Slot Identifier
props.description: The identifier of the most recently assigned action slot. The slot identifies which sub-set of the Action is considered to be for this data-block, and its identifier is used to find the right slot when assigning an Action.

props.name: Action Slot
props.description: The slot identifies which sub-set of the Action is considered to be for this data-block, and its name is used to find the right slot when assigning an Action

props.name: Slots
props.description: The list of slots in this animation data-block

funcs.description: Convert a time value from the local time of the tweaked strip to scene time, exactly as done by built-in key editing tools. Returns the input time unchanged if not tweaking.

params.name: Invert
params.description: Convert scene time to action time

funcs.description: Rename the property paths in the animation system, since properties are animated via string paths, it's needed to keep them valid after properties has been renamed
